pdf-workspace.name: PDF Workspace
pdf-workspace.description: Edit, redact, sign, stamp and secure one document without leaving the page
pdf-workspace.seoTitle: PDF Workspace — Edit, Sign, Redact & Secure PDFs Online
pdf-workspace.metaDescription: One PDF workspace to edit text, redact sensitive info, add signatures, stamp watermarks and password-protect documents. Everything runs in your browser.

faqs.q: What can I do in the PDF Workspace?
faqs.a: You can edit text, redact sensitive information, reorder pages, add signatures, stamp watermarks, adjust pages, password-protect the document, and download the result — all without leaving the page.

faqs.q: Is my document uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: No. Every action runs in your browser. Your document never leaves your device, making the workspace ideal for confidential and sensitive work.

faqs.q: Is the PDF Workspace free, and do I need an account?
faqs.a: It is free with no account, no watermark and no limit on how many documents you work on. Open a PDF and start editing.

howTo.title: How to edit, sign and protect a PDF in one place
howTo.intro: The PDF Workspace puts editing, redaction, page tools, signatures, stamps and passwords on one screen, with undo and redo, so you finish a document in one pass and download it once.
steps: Open your PDF in the workspace above (unlock it first if it has a password)
Use the Edit, Redact, Pages, Sign, Stamp, Adjust and Protect tabs in any order
Step back or forward through your history if you change your mind
Click Download to save the finished PDF
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Works in any modern browser on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android

merge-pdf.name: Merge PDF
merge-pdf.description: Combine multiple PDFs into a single file
merge-pdf.seoTitle: Merge PDF — Combine Multiple PDFs Into One (Free Online)
merge-pdf.metaDescription: Combine two or more PDF files into a single document. Free, no sign-up, no watermarks. Merging happens in your browser — files are never uploaded.

faqs.q: How many PDFs can I merge at once?
faqs.a: Up to 20 files per merge, with no size cap beyond your device memory. For more, merge in batches of 20, then merge the results together.

faqs.q: Does merging reduce PDF quality?
faqs.a: No. A correct merge copies each page object into a new document without re-encoding images or text. Your pages remain identical to the originals.

faqs.q: Can I merge password-protected PDFs?
faqs.a: You need to unlock them first. Password-protected PDFs cannot be read until the password is removed.

howTo.title: How to merge PDF files
howTo.intro: Merge PDF joins two or more PDFs into one document in the order you select them. Pages are copied as they are, so text stays selectable and images keep their resolution.
steps: Select or drop at least two PDF files, up to 20 at a time, in the order you want them
Check the list, and remove any file you added by mistake
Click Merge PDFs
Download the combined PDF
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Lossless — pages are copied, not re-rendered

split-pdf.name: Split PDF
split-pdf.description: Separate a PDF into individual pages
split-pdf.seoTitle: Split PDF — Separate a PDF Into Individual Pages
split-pdf.metaDescription: Break a PDF into single pages or custom page ranges. Free, browser-based, no upload required. Download individual pages or groups instantly.

faqs.q: How do I split a PDF into specific page ranges?
faqs.a: Enter ranges like 1-5, 10, 15-20. The tool splits the document into separate files for each range.

faqs.q: Does splitting reduce quality?
faqs.a: No. Splitting copies whole page objects into new documents. Text stays selectable and images keep their original resolution.

faqs.q: Can I split a PDF on my phone without an app?
faqs.a: Yes. Split PDF runs in the browser on Android and iPhone, so you can split a file without installing anything or uploading it.

howTo.title: How to split a PDF
howTo.intro: Split PDF cuts one document into several files by page range. Each range you type becomes its own PDF.
steps: Choose the PDF you want to split
Type the page ranges, for example 1-3, 5, 7-10, and check the preview
Click Split PDF
Download each part, or use Download All to get every part in one ZIP
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Lossless — every page keeps its original text and images

remove-pages.name: Remove Pages
remove-pages.description: Delete specific pages from a PDF
remove-pages.seoTitle: Remove Pages From PDF — Delete Unwanted Pages Free
remove-pages.metaDescription: Delete specific pages from a PDF document. Select the pages you want to remove and download the updated file. Free, no sign-up.

faqs.q: Can I remove multiple pages at once?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter multiple page numbers or ranges, and all selected pages will be removed in one step.

faqs.q: Is this the same as splitting?
faqs.a: No. Splitting creates separate files from selected pages. Removing deletes pages from the document while keeping the rest as a single file.

faqs.q: Is it safe to delete pages from a confidential PDF here?
faqs.a: Yes. The pages are removed in your browser and the file never leaves your device, so nothing is stored on a server.

howTo.title: How to remove pages from a PDF
howTo.intro: Remove Pages deletes the pages you list and keeps everything else in a single PDF, in the original order.
steps: Choose your PDF
Type the pages to delete, for example 1, 3, 5-8
Check the preview of the pages that will remain
Click Remove Pages and download the shorter PDF
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Works in any modern browser on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android

extract-pages.name: Extract Pages
extract-pages.description: Extract specific pages as a new PDF
extract-pages.seoTitle: Extract Pages From PDF — Pull Out Specific Pages
extract-pages.metaDescription: Extract specific pages from a PDF into a new document. Choose individual pages, ranges, or a mix. The original PDF stays unchanged.

faqs.q: Does extraction change the original PDF?
faqs.a: No. Extraction reads the source and writes a new file. Your original remains untouched on disk.

faqs.q: Can I extract pages in a different order?
faqs.a: Yes. List the pages in the order you want them. Entering 9, 3, 5 produces a file with pages in that sequence.

faqs.q: Is extracting pages free, with no watermark?
faqs.a: Yes. Extraction is free with no account, and the new PDF carries no watermark or added branding.

howTo.title: How to extract pages from a PDF
howTo.intro: Extract Pages copies the pages you choose into a new PDF and leaves the original file untouched.
steps: Choose your PDF
Type the pages you want, for example 1, 3, 5-8, and check the thumbnails
Click Extract Pages
Download the new PDF that contains only those pages
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Works in any modern browser on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android

organize-pdf.name: Organize PDF
organize-pdf.seoTitle: Organize PDF — Reorder & Remove Pages Free
organize-pdf.metaDescription: Put the pages of a PDF in any order and drop the ones you do not need, in one step. Free, no sign-up, and the file never leaves your browser.

faqs.q: How do I set the new page order?
faqs.a: Type the page numbers in the order you want, for example 3, 1, 2, 4. The current order is filled in for you, and a preview shows the result before you save.

faqs.q: Can I rotate pages here?
faqs.a: No. Use Rotate PDF, which turns all pages or just the ones you list by 90°, 180° or 270°.

faqs.q: Can I mix pages from different PDFs?
faqs.a: The organize tool works on a single PDF. To combine pages from different files, use Merge PDF after extracting the pages you need.

howTo.title: How to reorder pages in a PDF
howTo.intro: Organize PDF rebuilds a document in the page order you type. Any page you leave out of the list is dropped, so you can reorder and trim in one step.
steps: Choose your PDF — the current order (1, 2, 3 …) is filled in for you
Rewrite the list in the order you want, for example 3, 1, 2, 4
Check the preview of the new order
Click Organize PDF and download the result
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Works in any modern browser on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android

compress-pdf.name: Compress PDF
compress-pdf.description: Reduce file size while maintaining quality
compress-pdf.seoTitle: Compress PDF — Reduce File Size Without Losing Quality
compress-pdf.metaDescription: Shrink PDF file size by up to 80% without visible quality loss. Free, browser-based compression. No uploads, no watermarks, no sign-up.

faqs.q: Will compressing a PDF reduce its quality?
faqs.a: At the recommended compression level, images are re-encoded at 150 DPI — visually identical to the original for screen viewing and standard printing.

faqs.q: How much smaller will my PDF get?
faqs.a: Photo-heavy PDFs shrink 60-80%. Text-only files shrink 10-30%. Scanned documents can shrink up to 90%.

faqs.q: Can I compress a password-protected PDF?
faqs.a: You need to unlock it first. Compression tools cannot read encrypted files until the password is removed.

howTo.title: How to compress a PDF to a specific size
howTo.intro: Compress PDF works towards a target size you set, in MB or KB, instead of vague "low / medium / high" levels — useful when an upload form or email has a hard limit.
steps: Choose the PDF you want to shrink
Type a target size, or pick a quick preset of 50%, 25%, 10% or 5% of the original
Click Compress
Check the new size, then download the compressed PDF
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Honest about trade-offs: the tool warns you when a target is so small that pages must become images

optimize-pdf.name: Optimize PDF
optimize-pdf.description: Optimize PDF for web and faster loading
optimize-pdf.seoTitle: Optimize PDF — Speed Up PDF for Web & Faster Loading
optimize-pdf.metaDescription: Optimize PDF files for web delivery and faster loading. Reduce render time, flatten layers, and streamline the document structure.

faqs.q: What does PDF optimization do?
faqs.a: Optimization removes unused objects, flattens interactive layers, subsets fonts, and streamlines the internal structure for faster rendering.

faqs.q: Is optimization the same as compression?
faqs.a: Compression reduces file size by re-encoding images. Optimization focuses on structural improvements that speed up loading and rendering.

faqs.q: Will an optimized PDF still open in every PDF reader?
faqs.a: Yes. Optimization keeps the file a standard PDF, so it opens in Adobe Reader, browsers, Preview and mobile viewers as before.

howTo.title: How to optimize a PDF without losing quality
howTo.intro: Optimize PDF repacks the file structure — object streams, unused objects — without touching images or text. If there is nothing to gain, it returns your file unchanged and says so.
steps: Choose one or more PDFs
Tick "Remove document metadata" if you also want title, author and similar fields cleared
Click Optimize PDF
Download the optimized file, or use Compress PDF if you need a bigger reduction
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Works in any modern browser on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android

repair-pdf.name: Repair PDF
repair-pdf.description: Fix corrupted or damaged PDF files
repair-pdf.seoTitle: Repair PDF — Fix Corrupted or Damaged PDF Files
repair-pdf.metaDescription: Repair corrupted or damaged PDF files. Fix broken headers, recover readable content, and restore damaged documents. Free online tool.

faqs.q: What causes a PDF to become corrupted?
faqs.a: Common causes include incomplete downloads, storage media errors, software crashes during save, and virus damage.

faqs.q: Can repair recover all content?
faqs.a: Repair works by rebuilding the PDF structure. Recovery depends on how much of the original data remains intact.

faqs.q: Is my damaged PDF uploaded for repair?
faqs.a: No. The repair runs in your browser, so a damaged contract or statement never leaves your device.

howTo.title: How to repair a corrupted PDF
howTo.intro: Repair PDF rebuilds a damaged file's cross-reference table, object numbering and trailer. If the structure cannot be recovered, it re-renders the pages into a new PDF with a searchable text layer.
steps: Choose the PDF that will not open or shows errors
Click Repair PDF
Download the repaired file and open it to check every page
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Works in any modern browser on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android

ocr-pdf.name: OCR PDF
ocr-pdf.seoTitle: OCR PDF — Extract Text From Scanned Documents
ocr-pdf.metaDescription: Convert scanned documents into searchable, selectable text using OCR. Make scanned PDFs searchable and editable. Free, no upload required.

faqs.q: What is OCR?
faqs.a: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) analyzes images of text and converts them into actual text characters, making scanned documents searchable and selectable.

faqs.q: How accurate is OCR?
faqs.a: Accuracy depends on scan quality. Clear, high-resolution scans typically achieve 95-99% accuracy. Poor quality scans may have more errors.

faqs.q: Does OCR PDF upload my scans?
faqs.a: No. The recognition engine and its language data download to your browser once, then every page is read on your own device.

howTo.title: How to make a scanned PDF searchable with OCR
howTo.intro: OCR PDF recognizes the text in scanned pages and adds it to the PDF, so you can search, select and copy it. You can pick up to three document languages from 44.
steps: Choose your scanned PDF
Search for and select the document language — up to three for mixed-language files
Click Start OCR and wait while each page is read
Download the searchable PDF
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Recognition runs on your own device, so sensitive scans stay with you

jpg-to-pdf.name: JPG to PDF
jpg-to-pdf.seoTitle: JPG to PDF — Convert Images to PDF Documents Free
jpg-to-pdf.metaDescription: Convert JPG images to PDF documents. Maintain original image quality. Combine multiple images into one PDF. Free, no sign-up required.

faqs.q: Does converting JPG to PDF reduce image quality?
faqs.a: No. The image data is embedded into the PDF without re-compression. Your images remain pixel-identical to the originals.

faqs.q: Can I combine multiple images into one PDF?
faqs.a: Yes. Load all your JPGs, arrange them in order, and convert. Each image becomes one page in the resulting PDF.

faqs.q: Can I convert photos to PDF on my phone?
faqs.a: Yes. Open JPG to PDF in your phone's browser, pick photos from your gallery, and download one PDF. Nothing is uploaded.

howTo.title: How to convert JPG to PDF
howTo.intro: JPG to PDF combines JPEG, PNG and WebP images into a single PDF, one image per page, in the order you add them.
steps: Select or drop your images, up to 20 at a time, in the order you want the pages
Click Convert to PDF
Download one PDF that contains every image
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Works in any modern browser on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android

scan-pdf.name: Scan PDF
scan-pdf.description: Scan documents with your camera and save as PDF
scan-pdf.seoTitle: Scan to PDF Online Free — Camera Scanner, No App
scan-pdf.metaDescription: Scan documents to PDF online with your phone camera: auto edge detection, crop, filters, OCR, ID and book modes. Free, no app, no sign-up, no upload.

faqs.q: Do I need an app or a scanner to make a PDF?
faqs.a: No. Open this page on your phone and point the camera at the page. It finds the edges, captures the page when you hold steady, straightens it and cleans up shadows. You can also import photos you already took.

faqs.q: Is my scanned document uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: No. The camera stream, page detection, filters and PDF creation all run in your browser. Pages are kept on this device so a reload does not lose them. The only download is the text-recognition language model, fetched once if you turn on OCR.

faqs.q: Can I make the scanned PDF searchable?
faqs.a: Yes. Leave "Recognize text (OCR)" on when you save. The recognized text is laid invisibly over each page image, so you can search, select and copy it. Accuracy depends on how sharp and well-lit the photo is.

faqs.q: What do the Book, ID card and Whiteboard modes do?
faqs.a: Book splits an open book into a left and a right page. ID card scans the front and then the back of a card and places both on one page at real size. Whiteboard whitens glare and boosts marker colours.

faqs.q: Can I fix a page after scanning it?
faqs.a: Yes. In Review you can drag the corners to re-crop, rotate, change the filter, adjust brightness and contrast, brush away marks, draw, highlight, add text or sign, retake, reorder or delete any page, and undo any change. Edits are applied to the original photo, so nothing loses quality.

faqs.q: Can I scan a business card into my contacts?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Business card mode, then tap Contact: the name, job title, company, phone, email and website are read from the card for you to check, and saved as a .vcf contact file your phone can import.

faqs.q: Can I password-protect the scan or save it as JPG?
faqs.a: Yes. When saving, tick "Protect with a password" to lock the PDF, or choose JPG to get one image per page. Saved PDFs are also kept in Recent scans on this device so you can download or share them again.

howTo.title: How to scan a document to PDF with your phone
howTo.intro: Scan PDF turns your phone or laptop camera into a document scanner: it finds the page edges, straightens the page and cleans it up, then saves a PDF you can make searchable.
steps: Allow camera access, or add photos you already took
Hold the page in view — the edges are detected and the page is cropped and straightened
Review each page: re-crop, rotate, pick a filter such as B&W or Whiteboard, or retake it
Choose the page size and file size, turn on text recognition (OCR) if you want it, and save as PDF or JPG
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Scans stay on your device, including the copies kept in Recent scans

word-to-pdf.name: Word to PDF
word-to-pdf.description: Turn a document (DOCX) into a PDF
word-to-pdf.seoTitle: Word to PDF — Convert DOCX to PDF Free Online
word-to-pdf.metaDescription: Convert Word documents (DOCX) to PDF in your browser. Keeps your text, headings, lists and tables. Free, no sign-up, and no upload.

faqs.q: Will my formatting be preserved?
faqs.a: Your text, headings, lists and tables come across, but the document is re-typeset rather than copied pixel for pixel, so custom fonts and complex page layouts will not match exactly. For a pixel-perfect copy, use File → Save as PDF in Word itself.

faqs.q: Do I need Microsoft Word installed?
faqs.a: No. The conversion happens in your browser. No software installation is required.

faqs.q: Is my Word document uploaded to convert it?
faqs.a: No. The DOCX file is read and turned into a PDF in your browser, so it never leaves your device.

howTo.title: How to convert Word to PDF
howTo.intro: Word to PDF turns .docx files into PDFs in your browser. It keeps your text, headings, lists and tables, but re-typesets them, so complex layouts and custom fonts will not match the original exactly.
steps: Choose one or more .docx files
Click Convert to PDF
Download each PDF, or use Download All for a ZIP
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Works in any modern browser on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android

powerpoint-to-pdf.name: PowerPoint to PDF
powerpoint-to-pdf.seoTitle: PowerPoint to PDF — Convert PPTX to PDF Free
powerpoint-to-pdf.metaDescription: Convert PowerPoint presentations (PPTX) to PDF, one page per slide, with text, pictures and tables. Free, no sign-up, and no upload.

faqs.q: Will animations be preserved?
faqs.a: Animations are converted to static pages since PDF does not support animations. The final state of each slide is captured.

faqs.q: Can I convert specific slides?
faqs.a: The conversion processes the entire presentation. To get specific slides, extract them after conversion using the Extract Pages tool.

faqs.q: Is my presentation uploaded to convert it?
faqs.a: No. The PPTX file is converted in your browser and never leaves your device.

howTo.title: How to convert PowerPoint to PDF
howTo.intro: PowerPoint to PDF redraws each slide of a .pptx file on its own page, with its text, pictures, tables and grouped shapes.
steps: Choose one or more .pptx files
Click Convert to PDF
Download the PDF — one page per slide
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Works in any modern browser on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android

excel-to-pdf.name: Excel to PDF
excel-to-pdf.description: Turn a spreadsheet (XLSX) into a PDF
excel-to-pdf.seoTitle: Excel to PDF — Convert Spreadsheets to PDF Free
excel-to-pdf.metaDescription: Convert Excel spreadsheets (XLSX or CSV) to PDF, each sheet fitted to the page width. Free, browser-based, no sign-up and no upload.

faqs.q: Will my formulas be preserved?
faqs.a: Formulas are calculated and saved as their resulting values in the PDF. The formulas themselves are not preserved since PDF is a static format.

faqs.q: Can I convert specific worksheets?
faqs.a: The conversion processes the entire workbook. For specific sheets, you may need to save them as a separate file first.

faqs.q: Is my spreadsheet uploaded to convert it?
faqs.a: No. The XLSX file is read and turned into a PDF in your browser, so financial data never leaves your device.

howTo.title: How to convert Excel to PDF
howTo.intro: Excel to PDF turns .xlsx and .csv files into PDFs. Each visible sheet is fitted to the page width, and portrait or landscape is chosen for you.
steps: Choose one or more .xlsx or .csv files (save old .xls files as .xlsx first)
Click Convert to PDF
Download the PDF; very large sheets show their first 3,000 rows
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Works in any modern browser on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android

html-to-pdf.name: HTML to PDF
html-to-pdf.seoTitle: HTML to PDF — Convert Web Pages to PDF Free
html-to-pdf.metaDescription: Convert any web page to PDF. Save articles, receipts, and online content as PDF documents. Free, browser-based, no installation.

faqs.q: Can I convert any web page?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter the URL of any publicly accessible web page and it will be converted to PDF format.

faqs.q: Will the PDF look like the web page?
faqs.a: The PDF captures the rendered content of the page. Complex layouts may vary slightly from the original.

faqs.q: Do I need to install anything to convert HTML to PDF?
faqs.a: No. Paste the HTML or choose an .html file and the PDF is created in your browser, with no software, extension or account.

howTo.title: How to convert HTML to PDF
howTo.intro: HTML to PDF takes pasted HTML or an uploaded .html file and produces a PDF, either matching the design or as simplified, selectable text.
steps: Paste your HTML code, or upload an .html file
Check the design preview
Choose Exact design or Selectable text
Click Convert to PDF to download it
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Works in any modern browser on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android

heic-to-pdf.name: HEIC to PDF
heic-to-pdf.description: Convert Apple HEIC images to PDF
heic-to-pdf.seoTitle: HEIC to PDF — Convert Apple HEIC Images to PDF Free
heic-to-pdf.metaDescription: Convert HEIC and HEIF photos from iPhone and iPad to PDF documents. Free, browser-based, no upload required. Preserves original image quality.

faqs.q: What is a HEIC file?
faqs.a: HEIC (High Efficiency Image Container) is the default image format used by iPhones and iPads since iOS 11. It offers better compression than JPEG but is not universally supported by all software.

faqs.q: Can I convert HEIC to PDF on my phone?
faqs.a: Yes. The browser-based tool works on iPhone and Android. Open it in Safari or Chrome, select your HEIC photos, and download the PDF.

faqs.q: Does conversion reduce image quality?
faqs.a: No. The HEIC image is decoded and embedded into the PDF at its original resolution. The visual quality is preserved.

howTo.title: How to convert HEIC to PDF
howTo.intro: HEIC to PDF turns iPhone and iPad photos saved as HEIC or HEIF into PDFs, without installing anything or sending your photos anywhere.
steps: Select your HEIC or HEIF photos
Click Convert to PDF — each photo becomes its own PDF
Download them one by one, or all at once as a ZIP
benefits: Private — the file is processed in your browser and never uploaded
Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Works in any modern browser on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android

webp-to-pdf.name: WebP to PDF
webp-to-pdf.description: Convert WebP images to PDF documents
webp-to-pdf.seoTitle: WebP to PDF — Convert WebP Images to PDF Free Online
webp-to-pdf.metaDescription: Convert WebP images to PDF documents in your browser. Free, no sign-up, no watermarks. Supports batch conversion with original quality preservation.

faqs.q: What is a WebP file?
faqs.a: WebP is a modern image format developed by Google that provides superior compression for images on the web. It is widely used in web design and online content.

faqs.q: Does converting WebP to PDF reduce quality?
faqs.a: No. The WebP image is decoded and embedded into the PDF at its original resolution without re-compression.

faqs.q: Can I convert multiple WebP files at once?
faqs.a: Yes. Select multiple WebP images and they will be combined into a single multi-page PDF with one image per page.

faqs.a: This is the one Slate PDF tool that sends data online: the extracted text goes to a free public translation service. Do not use it for confidential documents.

howTo.title: How to translate a PDF
howTo.intro: Translate PDF translates the text of a PDF into one of 42 languages and gives you the translation on screen or as a new text-only PDF. Unlike our other tools, it sends the text to a free online translation service — the page tells you before you start.
steps: Choose a PDF with real text (run OCR PDF first on scans)
Pick the source language, or leave it on Auto-detect, and the target language
Click Translate
Copy the translation, or download it as a PDF
benefits: Free, with no account, no watermark and no daily limit
Upfront about privacy: this is the one tool that sends text online, and it says so
Works in any modern browser on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android
